title: The Kind of Work a Godly Man Does When the Overtime Isn't Paid
caption:
Watch how a man treats the job that pays him nothing. That's the real him.

A godly man doesn't downgrade his effort once the reviewer stops watching or the check clears. He fixes the thing no manager would catch. He gives his mom's furniture the same care he'd give a client's.

Whatever you do, work at it with your whole heart, as for the Lord and not for men (Colossians 3:23). That doesn't have a clock-out time.

Where have you been giving your worst because nobody's paying for your best?
